transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. I came in today because... well, I've been having these eating episodes. And after they happen, I just feel so gross and disappointed in myself. I really feel like I should have more control over it, but I don't. It gets bad enough that I end up writing really awful things about myself in my journal. So, I figured I needed to talk to someone about it.
After these eating episodes, do you intentionally try to compensate in order to prevent weight gain?

No, I don't. I mean, I know some people might make themselves throw up or take laxatives and stuff, but I don't do anything like that. I don't really do extra workouts or starve myself the next day, either. I mostly just... sit there and feel terrible about it.
How often do these eating episodes happen?

For the past several months, it's usually been at least one night a week. I'll buy way too much food after work and just... eat it all in one stretch. It's been pretty consistent. I really can’t remember a recent month where it stopped for more than a week or so.
During these episodes, do you feel unable to control what or how much you are eating?

Yeah, pretty much. Once I start, it feels like I just keep reaching for the next thing almost automatically. Even while I’m thinking to myself, 'Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish,' I don’t actually stop. I just keep going until all the food is gone or I feel too uncomfortable to eat anymore.
